title: ESP, Teleports, fly, anti-fall, godmode parts, auto finish
features:
features - 


RED LIGHT, GREEN LIGHT
• Teleport to End — Teleports directly to the Red Light, Green Light end area.
• Remove Injury — Removes the injury effect.
• Dalgona Free Lighter — Grants a lighter for the Dalgona challenge.

HIDE & SEEK
• Kill Hiders — Targets players marked as Hiders.
• Teleport Up 100 Studs — Teleports 100 studs upward.
• Teleport Down 50 Studs — Teleports 50 studs downward.
• Hider ESP — Highlights players marked as Hiders.
• Seeker ESP — Highlights players marked as Seekers.
• Key ESP — Highlights dropped keys.
• Escape Door ESP — Highlights escape doors.

JUMP ROPE
• Teleport to End — Teleports to the Jump Rope end area.
• Delete Rope — Removes the rope effect.
• Anti-Fall — Creates a large barrier to prevent falling.

GLASS BRIDGE
• Glass Bridge ESP — Identifies glass panels:
  Green = Safe
  Red = Unsafe
  Yellow = Delayed Breaking
• Place Fake Parts — Creates platforms over unsafe glass.
• Destroy Fake Parts — Removes all placed platforms.
• Teleport to End — Teleports to the Glass Bridge end area.

REBELLION
• Auto-Shoot Guards — Automatically fires at guard NPCs using the gun remote.
• NPC Guard ESP — Highlights guard NPCs.
• Expand Guard Hitbox — Enlarges guard head hitboxes.

MINGLE
• Auto QTE — Automatically triggers the QTE remote.
• Teleport to Mingletron Room — Teleports directly to the Mingletron room.

FINAL SQUID GAME
• Final Killaura — Targets nearby players during the final Squid Game when 7 or fewer players remain.
• Squid Game Godmode — Creates a floating platform and positions the player above the arena.
